title: Add SBOM + provenance references (and optional embedded artifacts) to offline bundle manifest
creator: Connor O'Brien
project: On-prem offline artifact signing (Private Deployment Automation)
description:
Problem
Air-gapped customers need a way to validate what is in an offline bundle beyond “the bundle signature is valid.” We need to ship SBOM and provenance info in a way that can be validated fully offline and is auditable for regulated environments.

Goal
Extend the v1 offline bundle manifest so it includes SBOM + provenance pointers and/or embeds these artifacts inside the bundle. Document an offline validation workflow customers can follow.

Constraints
- Verification must work fully offline (no Rekor/Transparency Log lookups).
- Bundle signature remains the root integrity mechanism; SBOM/provenance artifacts must be covered by the same verification story (e.g., included in the manifest digests and therefore transitively protected by the bundle signature).
- Keep manifest deterministic (no non-deterministic ordering / timestamps unless explicitly excluded from determinism guarantees).

Proposal (v1)
1) Bundle layout
- Add metadata directory:
  - /metadata/sbom/
  - /metadata/provenance/
- Artifacts are optional but strongly recommended to embed for air-gapped installs.

2) Manifest schema additions
- Add top-level fields (names tentative; align with offline-bundle-format-spec-v1 once updated):
  - sbom: list of entries
  - provenance: list of entries
- Each entry includes:
  - type: e.g., "spdx-json", "cyclonedx-json", "slsa-provenance", "in-toto-attestation"
  - subject: what it describes (e.g., "bundle", "chart:redwood-control-plane", "image:registry/...@sha256:...", "binary:installer")
  - path: relative path inside bundle (preferred) OR uri: external reference (allowed but should be flagged as not-offline-verifiable)
  - digest: sha256 of the referenced artifact (required when path is used)
  - created_by: build pipeline identifier (e.g., "release-pipeline")
  - build_id: CI build identifier
  - source_repo + source_commit: link back to code provenance (string fields; no external calls required)

3) Offline validation workflow
- Primary: verify bundle signature + manifest, then verify the SBOM/provenance file digests match manifest digests.
- Secondary: customers may run their own tools offline to interpret the files:
  - SPDX/CycloneDX parsers
  - in-toto/slsa provenance verification (offline mode) using a provided public key and pinned builder identity (as applicable)

Out of scope (for this ticket)
- Transparency log integration (Rekor) and online verification.
- Customer-managed signing of Redwood-produced SBOM/provenance.
- Policy engine enforcement (e.g., “fail install if SBOM missing”); we will document recommended customer checks and optionally add a soft warning in installer later.

Deliverables
- Implement manifest generation changes in release tooling so that bundles produced by CI include:
  - Embedded SBOM(s) and provenance file(s) OR explicit manifest entries pointing to where they live.
  - Correct sha256 digests recorded for each referenced artifact.
- Update customer-facing documentation draft with an offline validation section (step-by-step commands) and troubleshooting guidance.

Acceptance Criteria
- A newly generated signed offline bundle contains /metadata/sbom and /metadata/provenance (or clearly documented why a given environment only produces pointers).
- Manifest contains sbom/provenance entries with correct sha256 digests.
- Installer verification (ENG-3914) continues to verify manifest + all files, which implicitly covers sbom/provenance files when embedded.
- CI integration test (ENG-3917) extended or a new test added to assert:
  - sbom/provenance entries exist
  - digests match
  - tampering with sbom/provenance causes verification failure.
- Docs (ENG-3918) includes offline instructions:
  - Verify bundle signature
  - Verify sbom/provenance digests
  - Optional: validate SLSA provenance offline (if we ship a verification key / identity policy)

Open Questions
- What formats are we standardizing on for v1?
  - Preference: SPDX JSON for SBOM, SLSA provenance (in-toto JSON) for build attestations.
- Per-image SBOM vs “bundle-level SBOM”:
  - v1 proposal: at minimum a bundle-level SBOM + references to image digests; optionally per-image SBOM when available without blowing up size.
- Size constraints for air-gapped media transfers:
  - Need guidance from Solutions Eng on typical max bundle sizes; may gate whether we embed per-image SBOM.

Links
- Confluence: Threat model – Offline artifact signing
- Confluence: Offline bundle format spec v1 (to be updated with schema)
- Linear: ENG-3912 (bundle format/manifest), ENG-3913 (signing stage), ENG-3914 (installer verify), ENG-3918 (docs)

Notes
This ticket is intentionally focused on “shipping + referencing + offline verifiability.” Deeper compliance reporting (exportable evidence packages) should be tracked separately once we see pilot feedback.

Assigning to Devon for implementation in release tooling; Marcus/Kevin to advise on security expectations.

2025-02-14 Devon Price: Took a first pass at manifest schema additions in the Drive draft. Leaning toward embedding SPDX JSON + SLSA provenance files under /metadata to keep it simple for air-gapped. Question: do we want multiple SBOMs (per component) or a single bundle SBOM in v1?

2025-02-17 Kevin Osei: From auditability POV, embedding is strongly preferred. If we only provide external URIs, customers will treat it as non-compliant for air-gapped. Also recommend we record (repo, commit, build_id) as strings in manifest even if provenance artifact exists; makes evidence exports easier.

2025-02-20 Marcus Lin: Security note: we should be careful not to claim we are “verifying SLSA provenance” unless we actually ship a verification policy/key and document offline verification steps. But we can safely say the provenance file is integrity-protected via bundle signing + digests.

2025-02-24 Devon Price: Implementation plan: update release tooling to (a) copy generated SBOM/provenance outputs into bundle under /metadata, (b) add entries to manifest with sha256, (c) ensure deterministic ordering. Will coordinate with Sahana on where CI emits SBOM/provenance artifacts today (some jobs already generate SPDX for containers).

2025-02-26 Sahana Iyer: CI currently produces SBOM for a subset of images in nightly; release job doesn’t yet. We can add a release-stage step to generate SPDX for the bundle “subject set” (charts + installer + image list). Might not get per-image SBOM in time for v1; recommend bundle-level SBOM + image digest inventory first.

2025-03-01 Devon Price: Started PR branch (not opened yet) to include /metadata/{sbom,provenance} in bundle output and update manifest generator. Next: wire in actual SBOM/provenance files from CI artifacts; currently using placeholder test fixtures for local runs.
